item.title: Nvidia: Product Marketing Management MBA Intern - Summer 2027
item.description:
locations
US, CA, Santa Clara
time type
Full time
posted on
Posted Today
job requisition id
JR2025672
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
As a product marketing manager intern with the NVIDIA Enterprise Desktop Products group, you will have the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in the field of product marketing! You will work closely with the product marketing team to support the development and execution of go-to-market strategies for new and existing products.
What you'll be doing:
Create content such as product collateral, data sheets, web pages, solution briefs, messaging briefs, customer, and sales training materials.
Work with the product team to position products against other products in the product portfolio as well as competing products.
Collaborate with sales enablement teams to provide materials necessary to enable OEM and channel partners to successfully position and sell our products.
Work with cross functional teams, including product management, engineering, sales, campaigns, partner management teams.
What we need to see:
Pursuing an MBA in product marketing or a related field (graduating in winter or summer 2028)
Demonstrated proficiency in clear and concise written communication and articulate verbal expression
Proficient in transforming complex data into engaging and informative customer-facing materials.
Consistently deliver outstanding results by demonstrating exceptional organizational skills, as evidenced by consistently meeting or exceeding project deadlines and targets while successfully handling multiple tasks concurrently, showcasing proficient multitasking abilities.
Hands-on experience with AI assistants and agentic workflows to accelerate day-to-day work
NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers; we have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to unparalleled growth, best-in-class teams are rapidly growing. If you’re creative and autonomous with a real passion for your work, we want to hear from you!
Our internship hourly rates are a standard pay based on the position, your location, year in school, degree, and experience. The hourly rate for our interns is 38 USD - 94 USD.
You will also be eligible for Intern benefits.
Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 20, 2026.
This posting is for an existing vacancy.
NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.
NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

item.description:

Job Details:
Job Description:
Are you passionate about computer graphics? Working with leading engineers on Intel's latest GPU architecture? Now is the time to make your education count and work at Intel. As a PEY student, you can contribute to Intel's technology innovation. At Intel, we have a dynamic work environment with a team of experts and unique opportunities for your career development. You can enjoy your work at Intel with managers and colleagues who are eager to mentor you and help you to grow.

The Thermal Mechanical group is part of the Platform Design Engineering team and is responsible for thermal, mechanical, and acoustic design & validation of Intel's AI & discrete graphics cards. The team is an essential part of delivering Intel's 3D graphics, media, display GPU, and AI inference technology. We are looking for a highly motivated, passionate individual who would contribute to the design and validation of our next generation of discrete graphics hardware and work with cutting edge design technologies.
What You’ll Do
Depending on project and team needs, you may have the key responsibilities will include but not limited to:
Mechanical, thermal, and acoustic testing of graphics cards.
Thermal management firmware validation using Python.
Building computer systems and server-grade test setups.
Developing scripts to automate test procedures and test reports.
Preparing test reports.
Mid to high volume data analysis.
Data presentation including analysis and recommendation to larger team.
Vendor management and communication.
Design of test fixtures in CAD.
Organizing and maintenance of lab equipment, including ordering of needed items and keeping inventory.
Behavioral traits that we are looking for:
Curiosity and learning agility: Eager to learn new engineering concepts, tools, and technologies.
Analytical problem-solving: Uses data and a structured approach to investigate technical problems.
Attention to detail: Carefully conducts testing, evaluates results, and documents findings.
Collaboration: Works effectively with teammates and cross-functional engineering partners.
Communication: Clearly communicates observations, results, questions, and technical information.
Initiative: Takes ownership of assigned work while seeking guidance when appropriate.
Adaptability: Comfortable learning and working across different engineering disciplines.
Intel invests in our people and offers a complete and competitive package of benefits employees and their families through every stage of life.
Qualifications:
You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates. Requirements listed would be obtained through a combination of industry relevant job experience, internship experiences and or schoolwork/classes/research.

Minimum Qualifications and Experience:

Candidate must be pursuing a bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or other science/engineering related field.
Candidate must also have 3+ months of educational or work experience with the following:
Labs skills including test setup preparation and data acquisition.
Data analysis including experience working with programming languages and Excel.
Programming skills in Python or similar languages.
3D modeling and mechanical design skills using Creo (at a minimum a good working knowledge of SolidWorks is required).
Preferred Qualification and Experience to stand out above the crowd:
Strong fundamental knowledge of computer architecture, computer organization.
Experience with lab equipment such as oscilloscopes/multimeters/power supplies/etc.
Computer enthusiasts and excellent knowledge of current leading PC technology.
Experience with Linux command line, drivers, virtualization, datacenters, servers.
General knowledge of discrete graphics add-in cards or mobile discrete graphics systems.
Familiarity with running AI models.
Experience in building your own PC.
Applicable work/experience in a lab environment.
Deeper project work in Programming/Scripting languages such as Python.
Why Join Intel?
Help shape the future of GPU hardware. As an intern, you'll gain hands-on engineering experience supporting Intel's discrete graphics platforms while learning how thermal, mechanical, and system-level considerations influence hardware performance and reliability. You'll work alongside experienced engineers, apply your classroom knowledge to real technical challenges, and build practical skills that can help launch your engineering career.

Job Details:
Job Description:
The Role and Impact

Are you interested in GPU and AI accelerator hardware and want hands-on experience designing and bringing new technology to life?

As a GPU & AI Accelerator Hardware Design Undergraduate Intern, you will work alongside experienced engineers developing next-generation GPU and AI accelerator platforms. You will gain practical experience across PCB and board design, power delivery, circuit design, simulation, board bring-up, validation, debugging, and automation.

This internship provides an opportunity to apply concepts learned through coursework, labs, research, and technical projects to real-world hardware challenges while collaborating with Intel's cross-functional engineering teams.

What You’ll Do
Depending on project and team needs, you mayhave the key responsibilities will include but not limited to:
Support GPU and AI accelerator board and power design from concept through bring-up and validation.
Assist with PCB schematic design, layout, component selection, and Bill of Materials (BOM) development.
Learn to troubleshoot challenges involving high-speed board, power, digital, and analog design.
Use engineering and simulation tools such as Cadence, Sigrity, SIMetrix, Mathcad, MATLAB, PowerDC, or similar tools.
Participate in board bring-up, characterization, validation, and hardware debug.
Use laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes and thermal measurement equipment and support soldering/rework activities.
Assist with evaluating power requirements and power-delivery solutions for GPU and AI accelerator designs.
Develop or improve test methods and use Python or other scripting languages to automate measurements and data collection.
Gain exposure to microcontroller and FPGA firmware design and debugging.
Collaborate with board, layout, thermal-mechanical, validation, firmware, software, and other engineering teams.
Research and evaluate technologies that can improve future hardware designs and engineering processes.
Behavioral traits that we are looking for:
Curiosity and learning agility: Eager to learn new technologies, tools, and hardware-design concepts.
Problem-solving: Uses a structured approach to investigate and troubleshoot technical issues.
Attention to detail: Carefully evaluates designs, measurements, and test results.
Collaboration: Works effectively with engineering partners across different disciplines.
Communication: Clearly shares technical observations, questions, and results.
Initiative: Takes ownership of assignments and proactively seeks guidance when needed.
Innovation mindset: Looks for opportunities to improve tools, designs, and processes.
Proactive mindset: Anticipates needs, identifies potential challenges early, and takes appropriate action without waiting to be asked.
Intel invests in our people and offers a complete and competitive package of benefits employees and their families through every stage of life.
Qualifications:
You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates. Requirements listed would be obtained through a combination of industry relevant job experience, internship experiences and or schoolwork/classes/research.

Minimum Qualifications and Experience:
Candidate must be pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Mechatronics Engineering, or other relevant science/engineering related field.

Candidate must also have 3+ months of educational or work experience with the following:
Hardware design principles and PCB layout techniques.
Experience with board bring-up, debugging tools, and electrical measurements.
Design software such as Cadence, Altium, or similar tools.
AI acceleration hardware and computing architectures.
Preferred Qualifications and Experience:
Discrete graphics add-in cards or mobile discrete graphics systems.
Knowledge of current leading PC technology.
Familiar with PC x86 architecture and excellent system level knowledge including CPU processor, multimedia, memory, PCIe, display technologies, power management, 3D graphics.
Experience in building your own PC and computer hardware.
Programming skills in Python or similar languages.

Why Join Intel?
Help build the hardware powering the next generation of GPU and AI computing. You'll gain hands-on experience designing, bringing up, and validating advanced hardware while learning from engineers across board, power, thermal, firmware, and validation disciplines. You'll apply what you've learned in the classroom to real engineering challenges and develop skills that can help launch your career in hardware engineering.

Job Details:
Job Description:
The Role and Impact:
As a Process Integration and Yield Engineering Intern, you will play a pivotal role in advancing semiconductor manufacturing processes. In this hands-on role, you will analyze defect data, conduct experiments, and refine process integration flows while supporting yield improvement initiatives. Collaborating with engineering teams, you will tackle technical challenges, optimize metrology strategies, and contribute to continuous process enhancements in a high-volume manufacturing environment.

Business Group:
Intel Foundry drives innovation in semiconductor manufacturing by developing and optimizing processes that enable cutting-edge technologies. As part of this team, you will contribute to Intel's mission of delivering world-class products while ensuring efficiency, quality, and scalability within high-volume production environments.

Key Responsibilities:
- Perform defect analysis to identify trends and recommend process adjustments.
- Conduct experiments to evaluate and optimize process integration flows.
- Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to troubleshoot process issues and refine metrology strategies.
- Support yield improvement initiatives through risk assessments and data-driven recommendations.
- Apply advanced data analysis techniques to enhance process performance and production efficiency.
- Participate in continuous improvement projects aligned with Intel's business goals.
Qualifications:
You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum qualifications and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates. Experience listed below would be obtained through a combination of your schoolwork, classes, research, relevant previous job, and/or internship experiences.

Minimum Qualifications:
- Must be actively pursuing a Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering, Physics, Electrical Engineering, Material Science, Chemistry, or a related scientific field.
- Proficiency in microscopy techniques.
- Knowledge of semiconductor device physics and circuit design.
- Basic scripting skills in Python or comparable programming languages.

Preferred Qualifications:
- 2nd or 3rd-year Ph.D. with coursework in semiconductor physics, electronics, or solid-state physics.
- Hands-on experience with semiconductor manufacturing processes, microscopy techniques, or engineering analysis tools.
- Knowledge in data analysis platforms such as JMP, Python, MATLAB, or similar tools.
- Familiarity with image analysis software and visual computing systems.
-GPA 3.0

Discover the opportunity to grow your technical expertise, contribute to groundbreaking innovations, and shape the future of semiconductor manufacturing. Apply today to be part of Intel's mission to advance technology that enriches lives worldwide.
